title: Per-Order Return Limits and Units Already on a Return
content:
All Returns & Exchanges returns of one order are read together. The limits below apply to the order as a whole and to each booked line on it, and are read from the system's records of the order's returns.

## The limits

1. **Authorizations per order.** An order can carry at most the return type's maximum number of return authorizations that are not cancelled or expired (three on every return type). Cancelled and expired authorizations are not counted.
2. **Units per booked line.** The units of a booked line placed on returns that are not cancelled or expired can never exceed the units booked on that line less the units cancelled. A unit already on an open or settled return cannot be put on another.
3. **Exchanges per line.** On exchanges, units of one booked line can be exchanged at most the number of times the return type allows (once on a Size Exchange or an Instant Exchange).
4. **Replacements.** A replacement received through an exchange is returned against the exchange order, never against the original order.

## What counts toward the unit limit

| Return holding units of the line | Counted |
|---|---|
| Authorized, in transit, received, inspected or settled | Yes |
| Cancelled | No |
| Expired | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A line booked with 3 units, 1 of them cancelled: 2 units can ever be on returns. With 1 unit on an open return, 1 more unit may be placed on a new return; a request for 2 more exceeds the limit.
- The same line with 1 unit on a settled return and 1 unit on an expired return: the settled unit counts and the expired one does not, so 1 unit remains returnable.
- An order with three authorizations, one of them expired: two count, so a further authorization is within the limit. With three that are open or settled, a fourth is not.
- A customer who received a replacement through a Size Exchange and now wants to return it: the replacement is returned against the no-charge exchange order, not against the order the original units came from.
